native_execution.scope: Swift 6.4 host-built arm64 binaries, executed in hardware-virtualised native arm64 macOS 26.0; no Intel emulation or physical-device claim.

scalar.methodology: Lossless scalar public API. Owned decode, release without sanitizers. Four alternating process blocks, each with 5 warmups and 5 timed iterations. Initial sample verification outside timing. Host is a developer workstation; no claim of isolated thermal/power control.

colour.methodology: RGB public API; selected_cases records the executed subset of the NEAR 0/3, three-interleave grid. Owned decode, release without sanitizers. Four alternating process blocks, each with 5 warmups and 5 timed iterations. Initial sample verification outside timing. Host is a developer workstation; no claim of isolated thermal/power control.

performance_acceptance: Not determined by the archiver; see the separately authored reviewed disposition and preserve all original ratios.

reviewed_performance_disposition.reviewed_status: Intermediate checkpoint: software and scoped workspace validation pass, RGB regressions resolved, tiny short-warm decode/preparation performance qualification remains open. Later candidates must receive separate source-pinned evidence.

findings.status: Resolved at bee49a2 in the selected 39-case RGB campaign; all pooled operation ratios within 1.05. Native writer optimisation preserves shared kernel and borrow lifetime.
Unresolved at bee49a2. Fixed 16-pair short-warm confirmation retains reproducible flat 12/16-bit regressions; noise/ramp findings have wider spreads. No waiver or automatic acceptance.
Unresolved at bee49a2. All six short-warm preparation pooled ratios exceed 1.05. Mandatory validation boundaries differ, but that does not waive measured costs.

Supplemental context only. Fixed deep-warm and same-process results are generally below threshold; same-source controls do not establish a stable binary gap. These do not override short-warm findings.

Diagnostic localisation only. Most short-minus-deep excess lies inside the codec budget wall-clock interval. This is not CPU attribution, proof of an executor mechanism, or a waiver. Micro clock-resolution zeros retained with documented validator correction and no reruns.

Explained header differences in 13 selected RGB cases: seven lossless +44-byte SPIFF envelopes and six NEAR3 net +29-byte SPIFF-minus-predecessor-LSE differences. Entropy and header-normalised streams equal; 26 bidirectional cross-decodes pass. Fidelity unchanged; not independent-oracle proof.

Finite scoped source inventory and 89-operation requested-heap attribution complete at bee49a2. Descriptor overhead measured; no unattributed codec allocations. Universal algorithm heap-plus-stack-plus-allocator total remains unknown; peakWorkspaceBytes remains nil.

workspace.scope: 89 marked operations, Swift 6.4 ordinary-release x86_64 Linux; downloaded measurement artifact replay, not CI status verification
limitations: Source inventory covers fixed and row-dependent algorithm storage; this finite matrix is not exhaustive input, option, error-path or ABI coverage.
Mapping fixture uses default options; explicit mappingOutputPrecision sample application is source-accounted, not measured by this matrix.

Category maxima occur at different instants and must not be added.
Owned pixel counts concern observed attributed allocations; source review and independent correctness/copy-mutation evidence remain necessary.
